load_25ohm_note: Fixed 25 ohm load; nominal target powers are 51.84 W at 36 V, 70.56 W at 42 V, and 92.16 W at 48 V.
convergence_rule: abs(mean(Vout)-Vref)<=0.5 V, Vout p-p<=1.0 V, abs(Vout slope)<=100 V/s, driver enable>0.5, fault latch N>0.5 in final 2 ms.
mode_rule: Controller source selects EPS when filtered abs(Iout)>=4 A; otherwise SPS after normal-mode entry. Mode below is inferred from final Iout.
